:::: {.hero .front}

# not knowing, yet

::: {.stand}
How to be in a body. How to be with others. How to make something together.
No answers yet — just people working at the edge of what they know.
:::
::::

::: {.band .band-front}
:::

NKY is a community project to support body-mind practitioners and therapists in
sharing and learning together.

It is run by [FG](about/fg.qmd) and [DS](about/ds.qmd).

::: {.ways}
[Three ways in]{.eyebrow}

::: {.way}
[The podcast]{.k}

Conversations with people who practise something with their bodies and think
about what they are doing — spiritual, somatic, therapeutic, community,
scientific. Two hosts, who do not always agree.

[the show →](podcast/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[The writing]{.k}

Learnings, experiences, thoughts, and long-form reading journeys through what is
known and not known about how bodies work.

[what we have written →](writing/index.qmd)
:::

::: {.way}
[Community]{.k}

Study sessions on a chosen text, and open online calls with a guest that anyone
can join and listen in on. Later, perhaps, a smaller and more private space for
practitioners.

[what happens, and how to join →](community/index.qmd)
:::
:::
